commands: set -eu; git fetch origin; git checkout main; git pull --ff-only origin main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c67752483b07ba88399c6e1e6940c33dd3a2f51f"; export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21); export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug

set -eu; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$TMP/pre.db"; PRE=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/pre.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); APK=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*debug*.apk' -type f | head -1); test -n "$APK"; adb install -r "$APK"; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 180; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$TMP/post.db"; POST=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/post.db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); echo PRE_MAX_TS=$PRE; echo POST_MAX_TS=$POST; test "$POST" -gt "$PRE"; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(deviceName,'') as name,coalesce(deviceType,'') as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,count(*) as samples,round(avg(rssi),1) as avgRssi,max(timestamp) as lastTs from signal_samples where timestamp >= $POST-240000 and (lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%wf-1000xm5%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%garmin%' or lower(coalesce(deviceName,'')) like '%forerunner%' or lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or manufacturerId=135) group by name,type,vendor,beacon order by samples desc limit 50;"; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/post.db" "select coalesce(lastDeviceName,'') as name,deviceType as type,coalesce(vendorName,'') as vendor,coalesce(predictedModel,'') as model,coalesce(beaconType,'') as beacon,trackingStatus as status,round(followingScore,1) as score,lastRssi as rssi from devices where lastSeenAt >= $POST-240000 and (lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%fmdn%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%gfps%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%wf-1000xm5%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%garmin%' or lower(coalesce(lastDeviceName,'')) like '%forerunner%' or lower(coalesce(beaconType,'')) like '%find hub%' or manufacturerId=135) order by lastSeenAt desc limit 50;"; rm -rf "$TMP"
